evidence.claim: Multiple merchants pay freelancers on Mostaql specifically to build a programmatic (custom-coded) link between Salla and their Odoo accounting instance, rather than use an app-store connector.

signals.problem: Small businesses without a full HR/payroll suite must manually keep Qiwa (labor contracts), Mudad (wage protection payroll upload) and GOSI (social insurance) in sync; content warns that any change must be reflected same-day across all three or the business risks financial/regulatory penalties.
signals.customer: Small Saudi businesses (a few to ~50 employees) doing HR/payroll administration without an integrated HR platform
signals.source: HR vendor blog content (search snippets only)

evidence.claim: Any modification made in Qiwa must be mirrored in Mudad and GOSI the same day; delaying synchronization by even a few days can trigger regulatory violations with financial and administrative costs.
evidence.source_title: دليل تكامل منصة قوى مع أنظمة الموارد البشرية 2026
evidence.summary: Vendor blog stating the same-day cross-sync requirement between Qiwa/Mudad/GOSI and the penalty risk of delay (per search snippet, not independently fetched).

evidence.claim: A payroll run on Mudad cannot be filed unless the employee is already registered in GOSI, and a Qiwa work-permit renewal cannot proceed unless GOSI monthly contributions are paid up to date — i.e. the three systems are interdependent but not natively linked for the employer.
evidence.summary: Article describing the interdependency between Qiwa, Mudad and GOSI compliance steps (per search snippet).

existing_solution.name: Bayzat
existing_solution.notes: Full HR/payroll platform automating Qiwa/Mudad/GOSI compliance; enterprise-oriented pricing likely out of reach for micro-businesses.

existing_solution.name: ZenHR
existing_solution.notes: Regional HR suite covering GOSI/WPS compliance.

signals.workaround: Micro-business owners/HR admins track changes manually across three separate government portals, often in spreadsheets, relying on memory/calendars to stay same-day compliant.
signals.potential_solution: A lightweight compliance-checklist/reminder tool (not a full payroll suite) that watches for changes and reminds/guides the small-business owner to update all three portals same-day — avoiding the cost of full HR suites, no deep API integration required if government APIs aren't public.
signals.business_model: Low-cost monthly subscription per company (micro-SME tier)
signals.existing_spend: NO RELIABLE EVIDENCE FOUND — no direct complaint, freelance request, or payment data found in this session (search budget was exhausted before a targeted Mostaql/complaint search could run).
unknowns: Whether GOSI/Mudad/Qiwa expose any public API a third party could legally use, or whether this is a portal-only (no-API) situation
Whether any direct complaints/freelance requests exist for this specific pain (not confirmed — evidence here is vendor-content only)
Real penalty amounts and how often small businesses actually get penalized for delayed sync
